items.t: NIO Just Dropped 22% in a Month. Is It a Buy Before Its Dec. 1 Report?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysNIO stock fell 22% in the past month, more than the Nasdaq 100, as Chinese EV makers XPeng and Li Auto sold off with it. October’s 34,246 deliveries were down 15.
